startConversationOptions.initialUserText: optional bounded text captured by a wake recognizer; after Provider readiness it is emitted as a finalized input transcript and submitted as the first real user turn

audioInput.capture: same-origin AudioWorkletProcessor batches Float32 microphone frames; the Client downsamples them to 16 kHz PCM for Doubao

standbyRecognition.implementation: browser SpeechRecognition; wake phrase matching remains in the product layer
standbyRecognition.billingBoundary: startConversation is called only by the product after a matching transcript
standbyRecognition.privacyNote: browser recognition is not claimed to be on-device unless the user agent explicitly guarantees it

standaloneBrowserClient.gateway: a bounded same-origin absolute path may retain product-owned authorization, versioned session setup, and readiness event

actionRegistry.resolution: registered name → execute(args, control) → resolveAction; unknown name under a matched owner → error result; unmatched owner → consumer resolves
actionRegistry.asyncResults: execute may return a Promise; speech continues while the result is pending (dual output); executors that never settle are resolved with a timeout error (action.timeoutMs per action, default 300000ms)
actionRegistry.control: execute may call control.resolve(result, options) to settle before follow-up work
actionRegistry.events: action-result emitted after every automatic resolution
